Is Deep Research Reliable? Misleading Knowledge Induces False Conclusions

分类方向评测与可靠性 / 评测体系主题evaluation / benchmarks
Pengyu Zhu, Lijun Li, Longju Yang, Sen Su
high · 2026-07-23

为什么值得看 这项工作把长程研究流程中的证据污染作为独立失效模式来测量：即使验证器在集中检查时能识别误导信息，研究代理仍可能在完整工作流中采用它并写出错误结论。对设计检索、验证和报告生成系统的研究者而言，结果说明单点事实核查不足，需要在模型和框架两层加入持续验证与纠错。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 3）
方法解读
01
问题

研究误导性知识如何在深度研究代理的规划、检索和报告流程中传播为错误结论。

02
方法

构造并验证具有可控权威程度和写作风格的误导性实例，并将其注入基于深度研究基准的任务。

03
差异

同时比较集中式验证与完整长程工作流中的信息使用，揭示两者之间的脱节。

04
证据

在开源和闭源代理上的实验显示少量暴露即可诱导错误结论，三类防御配置只能缓解而不能完全消除该问题。

摘要

深度研究代理将基于大语言模型的助手扩展为包含规划、检索、证据综合和报告生成的长程工作流，但其在开放信息环境中的可靠性仍缺乏研究。本文提出一种用于构造和验证误导性知识的框架，在深度研究基准任务上生成了五千九百三十三条经过质量控制的实例；跨开源和闭源代理的实验表明，少量误导信息也能诱导最终报告采纳错误结论，而集中式验证中能够识别这些信息的模型在长程研究中仍可能使用它们。三类研究前后防御措施均能缓解、但无法完全阻止错误结论采纳，表明可靠的深度研究需要模型层和框架层同时具备证据验证与纠错能力。

OSReward: Instituting Standardized Evaluation for Cross-Platform Computer-Use Reward Models

分类方向评测与可靠性 / 评测体系主题evaluation / benchmarks
Qiushi Sun, Kanzhi Cheng, Yian Wang, Bowen Yang, Hang Yan, Liheng Chen et al.
high · 2026-07-30

为什么值得看 这项工作直接检验计算机使用代理中作为奖励模型的视觉语言模型评审器是否可信，并显示现有模型普遍有“宽松偏差”，会把失败轨迹误判为成功。它同时提供困难样本、细粒度评分数据和九十亿及三百五十亿参数的开放奖励模型，为代理强化学习、数据筛选和大规模轨迹验证提供了比昂贵商业评审器更可部署的替代方案。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

工作研究视觉语言模型能否可靠判断跨平台计算机使用代理轨迹是否完成指令。

02
方法

作者收集多种代理骨干执行人工验证指令的轨迹，并通过多阶段人工标注建立真实判定、困难集和多维评分集。

03
差异

除评测现有评审器外，工作还用十万条带推理标注的判断语料训练开放式九十亿和三百五十亿参数奖励模型。

04
证据

全面评测发现领先模型存在把失败判为成功的宽松偏差，而所训练模型据称以低百分之三十至六十的成本匹配商业评审器。

摘要

计算机使用代理正在快速发展，而验证其是否完成任务是代理评测、数据构建和强化学习的核心；由于人工验证无法大规模进行，研究者越来越依赖视觉语言模型评审计算机使用轨迹。本文提出操作系统奖励基准，用经过多阶段人工标注的跨平台轨迹系统评估这类评审器，并构建困难集和细粒度效率与对齐评分集；结果显示，即使领先模型也存在系统性宽松偏差，可靠模型成本过高而开源模型明显落后。作者进一步发布带推理标注的十万条轨迹判断语料，并训练九十亿和三百五十亿参数的开放奖励模型，在成本降低百分之三十至六十的情况下匹配商业评审器的表现。

ClawTrack: Towards Trace-Level Evaluation and Improvement of Real-World Autonomous Agents

分类方向评测与可靠性 / 评测体系主题evaluation / benchmarks
Xingjian Wu, Xuhang Zhu, Xingchen Liu, Junlin Liu, Jianing Wang, Linsen Guo et al.
high · 2026-07-30

为什么值得看 这项工作把智能体评测从只看最终成败推进到逐步轨迹诊断，能帮助研究者区分可靠推理与偶然成功，并定位目标对齐、效率、信息利用和结果核验中的具体缺陷。其轨迹筛选还被用于后训练，并在不同模型规模上带来持续改进，尤其适合长流程工具调用和真实工作流智能体。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

最终结果评测无法揭示长程智能体的推理质量或具体失败原因。

02
方法

基准同时计算任务分数和过程分数，并用四个维度对每个推理轮次评分。

03
差异

它使用任务专属评分条目评估整条执行轨迹，而不是只判断任务是否完成。

04
证据

作者在八个领域的三百二十项任务、二十一种模型和一万六千多次试验上报告了归因能力、评判稳健性及后训练改进。

摘要

随着基于大语言模型的智能体被部署到复杂的多步骤工作流中，现有多数基准只判断最终结果，无法区分可靠推理与偶然成功，也难以将长程任务中的失败归因到具体过程缺陷。本文提出一种双重评估基准，同时衡量智能体完成了什么和如何完成；该基准包含八个领域的三百二十项任务、二十五个以上的确定性模拟服务，并由过程评分器依据一万二千五百四十一条任务专属评分条目，从目标对齐、效率、信息利用和结果核验四个维度为每个推理轮次评分。在二十一种模型和一万六千多次试验上的评估表明，过程分数能够归因成功与失败、过滤最终结果评测无法识别的偶然通过；四个维度彼此互补，其中结果核验是系统性瓶颈；该框架对不同评判大模型具有稳健性；基于过程的轨迹筛选可在不同模型规模上持续改善后训练效果。

Learning to Trace Seiberg Dualities

分类方向评测与可靠性 / 评测体系主题evaluation / benchmarks
Jonathan J. Heckman, Shani Meynet, Alessandro Mininno, Gary Shiu
medium · 2026-07-30

为什么值得看 这项工作把夸维尔突变转化为可学习的搜索任务，并比较了变换器网络、多层感知机与确定性算法在约十个节点规模上的效率；对研究推理、图结构搜索和理论物理基准的读者，它还显示将神经网络与路径查找算法结合可以进一步提升搜索效率和准确性。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

任务是在超对称夸维尔规范理论中判断两个系统是否通过塞贝格对偶性相连。

02
方法

作者将对偶性追踪建模为夸维尔突变学习，并测试变换器、多层感知机及其与路径查找算法的组合。

03
差异

方法用学习型搜索替代或辅助确定性突变算法，并把问题联系到学习解结的图结构任务。

04
证据

在节点数约为十的夸维尔上，网络通常优于确定性算法，加入路径查找器后效率和准确性进一步提升。

摘要

对偶性有助于揭示许多物理系统中的微观与涌现现象，但即使规则已知，判断两个系统是否对偶仍可能计算困难。本文使用机器学习研究超对称夸维尔规范理论中的塞贝格对偶性，将问题转化为学习夸维尔突变；实验表明，在节点数约为十的夸维尔上，由变换器和多层感知机构成的不同网络通常优于确定性算法，而结合成熟的路径查找算法还能提高搜索效率与准确性。

HARGO: Heterogeneity-Aware Reward-Guided Optimization for RL Post-Training of LLMs on HPC Tasks

分类方向推理、智能体与后训练 / 后训练与对齐主题reinforcement learning
Tiangang Li, Xiangbo Tian
high · 2026-07-30

为什么值得看 这项工作针对多任务强化学习后训练中常被忽略的任务异质性：分类、事实问答和语义生成的答案长度、奖励分布与初始准确率差异很大。它用奖励对比和参考模型置信度调节每条回答的权重，并且不需要任务类型标签；在四个高性能计算任务上，相比九种方法同时取得最高胜率、数据竞争检测的调和平均数和问答相似度，适合关注混合任务对齐的研究者。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

统一权重的强化学习后训练难以处理分类、事实问答和语义生成之间的奖励分布、答案长度与监督微调准确率差异。

02
方法

方法根据群体奖励对比计算区分信号，并用参考模型对数概率计算置信度信号，再调节优势值以获得逐回答权重。

03
差异

它不依赖任务类型标签，而是用奖励表现和模型置信度直接适应不同回答的训练重要性。

04
证据

在四个高性能计算任务和九种方法的比较中，它报告了百分之五十四点六二的胜率、百分之九十一点三零的数据竞争检测调和平均数和零点八五五八的性能语言提示相似度。

摘要

监督微调可以让大语言模型获得数据竞争检测和基准测试问答等高性能计算任务的领域知识，但知识并不保证模型产生符合任务要求的行为：同一个监督微调模型虽然能正确分类百分之八十八点六五的数据竞争样本，却会对事实查询生成冗长而不精确的回答，其中百分之六十五点九的机器学习性能基准回答超过四十个字符。强化学习后训练通过优化任务奖励来弥补这一问题，但高性能计算任务具有极强的异质性，因此统一权重方法并不理想。本文提出异质性感知奖励引导优化方法，利用群体奖励对比得到区分信号，利用参考模型对数概率得到置信度信号，在计算逐回答权重前调节优势值，且不需要任务类型标签；在四个任务和九种方法上，该方法在胜率、数据竞争检测调和平均数和性能语言提示相似度三个主要指标上均取得最佳结果，分别为百分之五十四点六二、百分之九十一点三零和零点八五五八。消融实验显示，两种信号具有互补作用。

Contrastive Reinforced Policy Optimization via Privileged Self-Distillation

分类方向推理、智能体与后训练 / 后训练与对齐主题reinforcement learning
Xingjian Wu, Junlin Liu, Xingchen Liu, Xuhang Zhu, Jianing Wang, Linsen Guo et al.
high · 2026-07-30

为什么值得看 这项工作直接针对长程多轮智能体后训练中的暴露偏差与推理路径趋同，将带特权教师信息的在线自蒸馏改造成基于预测熵的组内对比优化；如果论文所述结果成立，它可为强化学习奖励稀疏、而自蒸馏信号又存在偏差的场景提供更细粒度且更稳定的训练方向，并改善长程交互中的泛化。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

在线自蒸馏中的特权自教师会造成暴露偏差，并在多轮智能体训练中带来推理路径趋同。

02
方法

方法使用预测熵识别反思性探索位置和暴露偏差位置，再进行组内对比优化。

03
差异

它不是单独依赖可验证奖励或逐日志概率监督，而是从对比学习视角重新组织智能体在线自蒸馏信号。

04
证据

作者在十三个推理与深度搜索基准上报告了相对强化学习和自蒸馏基线的持续优势，以及更好的长程训练稳定性和泛化能力。

摘要

近期大语言模型后训练越来越多地采用可验证奖励强化学习或在线自蒸馏。在线自蒸馏虽然提供稠密的逐日志概率监督，却因自教师拥有特权信息而产生暴露偏差；在多轮智能体场景中，这会导致推理路径趋同并削弱明确的优化方向。为此，本文提出对比强化策略优化，从对比学习角度重构智能体在线自蒸馏，利用预测熵区分正位置（反思性探索）与负位置（暴露偏差），通过组内对比保留可靠而细粒度的优化信号；在十三个具有挑战性的推理与深度搜索基准上，作者报告该方法持续优于现有强化学习和自蒸馏基线，并显著提升长程交互中的训练稳定性与泛化能力。

TAPO: Transition-Aware Policy Optimization for LLM Agents

分类方向推理、智能体与后训练 / 后训练与对齐主题reinforcement learning
Cong Li, Peixi Peng, Yisen Zhao, Xinyu Hu, Shudong Liu, Zhan Su et al.
high · 2026-07-30

为什么值得看 这项工作把智能体在线交互中的环境反馈从被动的稀疏任务奖励，转化为动作条件的下一观测预测监督，并与策略优化交替进行。对使用强化学习训练多步任务智能体的研究者而言，它提供了一个无需专家数据、额外采样或推理开销的插件式改进，重点补足策略对环境转移和动作后果的建模能力。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

基于稀疏任务奖励的策略优化没有充分利用动作执行后已有的环境反馈。

02
方法

方法在同一骨干模型上交替执行策略优化和动作条件的下一观测预测监督。

03
差异

它把在线轨迹中的转移信息加入现有智能体强化学习算法，而不增加专家数据、采样成本或推理步骤。

04
证据

在网页购物和模拟家庭任务上，结合不同规模模型与多种策略优化算法的实验均报告了相对纯策略优化基线的稳定性能提升。

摘要

近期强化学习已成为大语言模型智能体后训练的重要方法，但现有方法主要依赖稀疏任务奖励，未能充分利用动作执行后自然产生的密集环境反馈。为此，本文提出一种面向大语言模型智能体的转移感知策略优化训练框架，在策略优化之外，利用共享骨干模型对动作条件下的下一观测进行预测监督，从而增强模型对环境转移动态和动作后果的敏感性。该方法无需额外专家数据、额外采样成本或推理时开销，并在网页购物和模拟家庭任务上结合不同规模基础模型及策略优化算法进行实验，结果显示其相较纯策略优化基线能稳定提升任务表现。

MMLDSum-LLM: Multimodal Long-Document Summarization with Visual-Alignment and Keyword-Aware

分类方向推理、智能体与后训练 / 后训练与对齐主题reinforcement learning
Xianpeng Zhang, Jiahua Yang, Dongyu Chen, Lei zhang, Jian Ma, Xu guohuan et al.
high · 2026-07-30

为什么值得看 这项工作同时补齐了多模态长文摘要的专门评测集和训练流程：先用视觉对齐与关键词加权监督微调，再用包含关键词覆盖、图文一致性、摘要质量和长度控制的多目标组策略优化强化学习，针对长上下文中的关键信息遗漏与跨模态幻觉提供了可复现实验路径。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

多模态大语言模型在长文档摘要中会因注意力漂移和图文对齐不足而遗漏关键信息或产生跨模态幻觉。

02
方法

方法先以视觉对齐加权损失和关键词感知加权损失进行监督微调，再用多目标奖励进行组策略优化强化学习。

03
差异

它把关键词覆盖、图文对齐、摘要质量和长度控制统一纳入训练奖励，并配套建立覆盖多领域和上下文尺度的多模态长文档摘要基准。

04
证据

作者在统一协议下与闭源及开源多模态模型比较，并报告关键信息覆盖和跨模态一致性得到显著提升。

摘要

方法解读
01
问题

02

深度研究代理将基于大语言模型的助手扩展为包含规划、检索、证据综合和报告生成的长程工作流，但其在开放信息环境中的可靠性仍缺乏研究。本文提出一种用于构造和验证误导性知识的框架，在深度研究基准任务上生成了五千九百三十三条经过质量控制的实例；跨开源和闭源代理的实验表明，少量误导信息也能诱导最终报告采纳错误结论，而集中式验证中能够识别这些信息的模型在长程研究中仍可能使用它们。三类研究前后防御措施均能缓解、但无法完全阻止错误结论采纳，表明可靠的深度研究需要模型层和框架层同时具备证据验证与纠错能力。

方法解读
01
问题

02
方法

基准同时计算任务分数和过程分数，并用四个维度对每个推理轮次评分。

摘要

随着基于大语言模型的智能体被部署到复杂的多步骤工作流中，现有多数基准只判断最终结果，无法区分可靠推理与偶然成功，也难以将长程任务中的失败归因到具体过程缺陷。本文提出一种双重评估基准，同时衡量智能体完成了什么和如何完成；该基准包含八个领域的三百二十项任务、二十五个以上的确定性模拟服务，并由过程评分器依据一万二千五百四十一条任务专属评分条目，从目标对齐、效率、信息利用和结果核验四个维度为每个推理轮次评分。在二十一种模型和一万六千多次试验上的评估表明，过程分数能够归因成功与失败、过滤最终结果评测无法识别的偶然通过；四个维度彼此互补，其中结果核验是系统性瓶颈；该框架对不同评判大模型具有稳健性；基于过程的轨迹筛选可在不同模型规模上持续改善后训练效果。

方法解读
01
问题

统一权重的强化学习后训练难以处理分类、事实问答和语义生成之间的奖励分布、答案长度与监督微调准确率差异。

02
方法

方法根据群体奖励对比计算区分信号，并用参考模型对数概率计算置信度信号，再调节优势值以获得逐回答权重。

03
差异

证据

在四个高性能计算任务和九种方法的比较中，它报告了百分之五十四点六二的胜率、百分之九十一点三零的数据竞争检测调和平均数和零点八五五八的性能语言提示相似度。

摘要

监督微调可以让大语言模型获得数据竞争检测和基准测试问答等高性能计算任务的领域知识，但知识并不保证模型产生符合任务要求的行为：同一个监督微调模型虽然能正确分类百分之八十八点六五的数据竞争样本，却会对事实查询生成冗长而不精确的回答，其中百分之六十五点九的机器学习性能基准回答超过四十个字符。强化学习后训练通过优化任务奖励来弥补这一问题，但高性能计算任务具有极强的异质性，因此统一权重方法并不理想。本文提出异质性感知奖励引导优化方法，利用群体奖励对比得到区分信号，利用参考模型对数概率得到置信度信号，在计算逐回答权重前调节优势值，且不需要任务类型标签；在四个任务和九种方法上，该方法在胜率、数据竞争检测调和平均数和性能语言提示相似度三个主要指标上均取得最佳结果，分别为百分之五十四点六二、百分之九十一点三零和零点八五五八。消融实验显示，两种信号具有互补作用。

Is Deep Research Reliable? Misleading Knowledge Induces False Conclusions

CategoryAreaEvaluation and Reliability / Evaluation SystemsTopicevaluation / benchmarks
Pengyu Zhu, Lijun Li, Longju Yang, Sen Su
high · 2026-07-23

Why it matters This work isolates evidence contamination as a failure mode in long-horizon research: agents may adopt misleading sources and produce false conclusions even when verifier models detect those sources during focused checks. For researchers building retrieval, verification, and reporting systems, the result argues that pointwise fact checking is insufficient and that correction must operate at both the model and workflow levels.

Source signalsHugging Face Daily Papers (community upvotes 👍 3)
Method brief
01
Problem

It studies how misleading knowledge propagates through planning, retrieval, synthesis, and report generation into false conclusions.

02
Method

It constructs quality-controlled misleading instances with controllable authority levels and styles and injects them into tasks from the DeepResearch Benchmark.

03
Difference

It compares focused corpus validation with evidence use inside complete long-horizon research workflows.

04
Evidence

Experiments across open- and closed-source agents show that limited exposure can induce false-conclusion adoption, while three defense configurations reduce but do not eliminate it.

Abstract

Deep Research agents extend LLM-based assistants into long-horizon workflows involving planning, retrieval, evidence synthesis, and report generation, yet their reliability in open information environments remains underexplored. A key concern is whether apparently credible but factually misleading knowledge encountered in such environments can propagate through these workflows and be adopted as false conclusions in final reports. To study this failure mode, we introduce MisKnow-Agent, a framework for constructing and validating misleading knowledge for Deep Research tasks. MisKnow-Agent generates misleading instances with controllable authority levels and styles, yielding 5,933 quality-controlled instances built on DeepResearch Benchmark tasks. Extensive experiments across open-source and closed-source Deep Research agents show that even limited exposure to misleading knowledge can induce false-conclusion adoption in final reports, revealing a broad reliability vulnerability in current Deep Research agents. Although search-enabled verifier models consistently identify the retained instances as misleading during focused corpus validation, the same instances can still be adopted during long-horizon research, revealing a disconnect between focused verification and workflow-level evidence use. Finally, we evaluate pre- and post-research defenses, both individually and in combination, finding that all three configurations mitigate but do not fully prevent false-conclusion adoption. Our findings suggest that reliable Deep Research requires evidence verification and correction capabilities at both the model and framework levels, beyond improvements in planning, retrieval, evidence integration, or report-generation abilities.

OSReward: Instituting Standardized Evaluation for Cross-Platform Computer-Use Reward Models

CategoryAreaEvaluation and Reliability / Evaluation SystemsTopicevaluation / benchmarks
Qiushi Sun, Kanzhi Cheng, Yian Wang, Bowen Yang, Hang Yan, Liheng Chen et al.
high · 2026-07-30

Why it matters This paper tests whether vision-language judges can serve as trustworthy reward models for computer-use agents and finds a systematic leniency bias: failed trajectories are often labeled successful. The benchmark, hard cases, fine-grained scores, and open 9B and 35B models give researchers concrete tools for trajectory filtering, agent reinforcement learning, and scalable verification without relying entirely on expensive commercial judges.

Source signalsarXiv indexed
Method brief
01
Problem

The work asks whether VLMs can reliably determine if cross-platform computer-use trajectories fulfill their instructions.

02
Method

It builds human-verified trajectory data from diverse agent backbones, adds multi-stage ground-truth labels, and derives hard and fine-grained evaluation sets.

03
Difference

Beyond benchmarking judges, it trains open 9B and 35B reward models on 100K reasoning-annotated trajectory judgments.

04
Evidence

The evaluation reports systematic leniency in leading judges, while the trained models are claimed to match commercial judges at 30–60% lower cost.

Abstract

Computer-using agents (CUAs) are advancing rapidly across the digital world. A CUA trajectory records the agent's actions, states, and reasoning. Verifying whether it fulfilled the task instruction is central to CUA evaluation, data curation, and reinforcement learning. Neither human-written verifiers nor human annotators can provide such verification at scale, so the field increasingly turns to vision-language models (VLMs) as judges of CUA trajectories. But a fundamental question has long gone unexamined: are these VLM judges reliable enough? To study it systematically, we introduce OSReward, a realistic, high-quality benchmark that evaluates VLM judges on CUA trajectories. The trajectories come from diverse agent backbones executing human-verified instructions across platforms, then rigorously labeled with ground-truth verdicts through multi-stage human annotation. Building on it, we derive OSReward-Hard, a challenge set concentrating genuinely hard cases, and OSReward-Multi for fine-grained efficiency and alignment scoring. The most comprehensive evaluation of VLM judges to date finds even state-of-the-art models fall short of an ideal judge, sharing a systematic leniency bias that mislabels failed runs as successes. The few reliable enough to trust are too expensive to run at scale, while affordable open models trail far behind. To close this gap, we construct and release OS-Shepherd-100K, an open corpus of reasoning-annotated trajectory judgments for the CUA community. On it, we train OS-Shepherd (9B and 35B), open reward models that supply low-cost, stable, and reliable reward signals, matching commercial judges at 30-60% lower cost than the frontier. Extensive analyses further inform the design of reliable CUA reward at scale. Our code, benchmark, dataset, and model checkpoints are available at https://os-copilot.github.io/OSReward-Home/.

ClawTrack: Towards Trace-Level Evaluation and Improvement of Real-World Autonomous Agents

CategoryAreaEvaluation and Reliability / Evaluation SystemsTopicevaluation / benchmarks
Xingjian Wu, Xuhang Zhu, Xingchen Liu, Junlin Liu, Jianing Wang, Linsen Guo et al.
high · 2026-07-30

Why it matters This work moves agent evaluation from final-outcome checks to step-level trajectory diagnosis, letting researchers separate reliable reasoning from lucky success and pinpoint failures in goal alignment, efficiency, information use, or result verification. Its trajectory filtering also improves post-training across model scales, making it useful for long-horizon tool-use agents and workflow automation.

Source signalsarXiv indexed
Method brief
01
Problem

Outcome-only benchmarks cannot expose reasoning quality or specific failure causes in long-horizon agent tasks.

02
Method

The benchmark jointly computes Task Score and Process Score, grading each reasoning turn on four dimensions.

03
Difference

It evaluates complete execution traces with task-specific rubric items instead of checking only whether the task was completed.

04
Evidence

The study covers 320 tasks in eight domains, 21 models, and more than 16,000 trials, reporting failure attribution, judge robustness, and post-training gains.

Abstract

As LLM-based agents are deployed in complex, multi-step workflows, a critical evaluation gap has emerged: most existing benchmarks judge only final outcomes, unable to distinguish reliable reasoning from lucky success or attribute failures to specific process deficiencies, hindering attribution in long-horizon tasks. In this work, we present ClawTrack, a dual-assessment benchmark that simultaneously measures what an agent achieves (Task Score) and how it achieves it (Process Score). ClawTrack comprises 320 tasks across 8 domains with 25+ deterministic mock services. A Process Grader scores each reasoning turn along four dimensions (goal alignment, efficiency, information utilization, and result verification), anchored by 12,541 task-specific rubric items. Evaluating 21 models over 16,000+ trials, we find that: (1) process scores effectively attribute success and failure to specific reasoning dimensions, filtering lucky passes invisible to outcome-only evaluation; (2) the four dimensions are complementary, with result verification as the systematic bottleneck; (3) the framework is robust to evaluator choice across different judge LLMs; and (4) process-based trajectory filtering yields consistent post-training improvements across model scales.

Learning to Trace Seiberg Dualities

CategoryAreaEvaluation and Reliability / Evaluation SystemsTopicevaluation / benchmarks
Jonathan J. Heckman, Shani Meynet, Alessandro Mininno, Gary Shiu
medium · 2026-07-30

Why it matters The paper turns quiver mutation into a learnable search problem and compares transformers, multilayer perceptrons, and deterministic solvers at roughly ten nodes. For researchers in reasoning, graph search, and scientific benchmarks, its main algorithmic takeaway is that combining learned proposals with pathfinder algorithms can improve search efficiency and accuracy.

Source signalsarXiv indexed
Method brief
01
Problem

The task is to determine whether two supersymmetric quiver gauge theories are connected by Seiberg duality.

02
Method

The authors learn quiver mutations with transformers and multilayer perceptrons, with optional pathfinder components.

03
Difference

The approach replaces or assists deterministic mutation searches with learned search policies and relates the task to learning to unknot.

04
Evidence

For quivers with roughly ten nodes, the networks generally outperform deterministic algorithms, while pathfinder augmentation further improves efficiency and accuracy.

Abstract

Dualities play an important role in establishing both microscopic and emergent phenomena in a wide range of physical systems. In practice, though, it can often be computationally challenging to establish when two systems are dual, even when all of the "rules of the game" are well-known. Said differently, when confronted with two systems, how can one efficiently establish that they are in fact dual? In this paper we use machine learning methods to address this question for Seiberg dualities of supersymmetric quiver gauge theories. Mathematically, this involves establishing mutations of quivers, which is in turn a variation on the theme of "learning to unknot". On the one hand, this leads us to a practical tool for establishing the computational complexity of different dualities. On the other hand, it also allows us to study how different network architectures learn how to trace Seiberg dualities. We find that for quivers with a modest number of quiver nodes (of order $10$), different network architectures consisting of transformers and multi-layer perceptrons tend to outperform deterministic algorithms. Supplementing the network by well-established pathfinder algorithms (essentially "Google Maps for quivers") leads to an additional improvement in the efficiency and accuracy of the search strategy. We anticipate that this class of questions can serve as a useful benchmark for frontier AI models applied to theoretical physics.

HARGO: Heterogeneity-Aware Reward-Guided Optimization for RL Post-Training of LLMs on HPC Tasks

CategoryAreaReasoning, Agents, and Post-Training / Post-Training and AlignmentTopicreinforcement learning
Tiangang Li, Xiangbo Tian
high · 2026-07-30

Why it matters This paper targets a practical failure mode in multi-task RL post-training: classification, factual QA, and semantic generation can have sharply different answer lengths, reward distributions, and SFT accuracy. Its response-level weighting uses reward contrast and reference-model confidence without task labels, and the reported gains across four HPC tasks suggest a useful alternative to uniform-weight methods for heterogeneous alignment workloads.

Source signalsarXiv indexed
Method brief
01
Problem

Uniform-weight RL post-training struggles when HPC tasks differ substantially in reward distributions, response lengths, and SFT performance.

02
Method

HARGO computes a discrimination signal from group-level reward contrast and a confidence signal from reference-model log probabilities, then modulates the advantage to produce per-response weights.

03
Difference

It adapts training weights from reward and confidence signals directly instead of requiring explicit task-type labels.

04
Evidence

Across four HPC tasks and nine methods, the paper reports 54.62% WinRate, 91.30% Data Race F1, and 0.8558 PLP Similarity, with ablations supporting complementary effects from both signals.

Abstract

Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can equip large language models (LLMs) with domain knowledge for high-performance computing (HPC) tasks such as data race detection and benchmark question answering. However, knowledge alone does not guarantee task-appropriate behavior: the same SFT model that correctly classifies 88.65\% of C/C++ data race samples produces verbose, imprecise answers to factual queries, with 65.9\% of MLPerf responses exceeding 40 characters. Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training addresses this gap by optimizing for task-specific rewards rather than token-level imitation. Yet HPC tasks exhibit extreme heterogeneity, with binary classification, factual QA, and semantic generation differing by 58x in answer length, spanning three distinct reward distributions, and showing widely varying SFT accuracy. This makes uniform-weight RL methods such as GRPO suboptimal. We propose HARGO, Heterogeneity-Aware Reward-Guided Optimization, which introduces per-response importance weighting via confidence-modulated advantage: computing a discrimination signal from group-level reward contrast and a confidence signal from reference model log-probabilities, then modulating the advantage before computing per-response weights, without requiring task-type labels. Across four HPC tasks and nine methods, HARGO achieves the best performance on all three primary metrics: WinRate 54.62\%, Data Race F1 91.30\%, and PLP Similarity 0.8558. Ablation confirms complementary contributions from both signals. HARGO establishes the best overall alignment quality among compared methods for heterogeneous HPC tasks.

Contrastive Reinforced Policy Optimization via Privileged Self-Distillation

CategoryAreaReasoning, Agents, and Post-Training / Post-Training and AlignmentTopicreinforcement learning
Xingjian Wu, Junlin Liu, Xingchen Liu, Xuhang Zhu, Jianing Wang, Linsen Guo et al.
high · 2026-07-30

Why it matters This paper targets exposure bias and reasoning-route collapse in long-horizon, multi-turn agent post-training. It turns privileged-teacher on-policy self-distillation into entropy-based group-wise contrastive optimization, potentially giving more reliable fine-grained updates when RL rewards are sparse and dense distillation signals are biased; the reported gains matter most for agents that must sustain reasoning over long interactions.

Source signalsarXiv indexed
Method brief
01
Problem

Privileged self-teachers create exposure bias, while multi-turn training can make agents converge to similar reasoning routes.

02
Method

CRPO uses predictive entropy to label reflective-exploration positions as positive and exposure-bias positions as negative, then applies group-wise contrastive optimization.

03
Difference

It reframes agentic on-policy self-distillation as a contrastive objective instead of relying only on verifiable rewards or token-level logit supervision.

04
Evidence

The authors report consistent gains over reinforcement-learning and self-distillation baselines on 13 reasoning and deep-search benchmarks, along with improved long-horizon stability and generalization.

Abstract

Recent advances in post-training Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly rely on Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) or On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD). While OPSD provides dense, logit-level supervision, it inherently suffers from exposure bias due to the privileged information of the self-teacher. In multi-turn agentic settings, this leads to reasoning route convergence and the loss of clear optimization directions. To tackle these challenges, we introduce Contrastive Reinforced Policy Optimization (CRPO), which reformulates agentic OPSD from a contrastive learning perspective. By leveraging predictive entropy to distinguish between positive positions (reflective exploration) and negative positions (exposure bias), CRPO conducts group-wise contrast to preserve reliable, fine-grained optimization signals. Extensive evaluations across 13 challenging reasoning and deep-search benchmarks demonstrate that CRPO consistently outperforms existing reinforcement learning and self-distillation baselines, significantly enhancing training stability and generalization in long-horizon interactions.

TAPO: Transition-Aware Policy Optimization for LLM Agents

CategoryAreaReasoning, Agents, and Post-Training / Post-Training and AlignmentTopicreinforcement learning
Cong Li, Peixi Peng, Yisen Zhao, Xinyu Hu, Shudong Liu, Zhan Su et al.
high · 2026-07-30

Why it matters TAPO turns dense environmental feedback from online interaction into action-conditioned next-observation supervision instead of using it only indirectly through sparse task rewards. For researchers training LLM agents with RL on multi-step tasks, this offers a plug-in way to improve sensitivity to transition dynamics without expert data, extra sampling, or inference-time cost.

Source signalsarXiv indexed
Method brief
01
Problem

Policy optimization driven mainly by sparse task rewards underuses the environmental feedback available after each action.

02
Method

TAPO alternates standard policy updates with action-conditioned next-observation prediction on a shared backbone model.

03
Difference

It adds transition supervision from existing rollout data to agent RL algorithms without extra expert data, sampling, or inference computation.

04
Evidence

Experiments on WebShop and ALFWorld with models at different scales and multiple policy optimization algorithms report consistent gains over pure policy optimization baselines.

Abstract

Recently, Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a crucial paradigm for the post-training of Large Language Model (LLM) agents. However, existing methods predominantly rely on sparse task rewards for policy optimization, failing to fully exploit another class of inherently dense supervisory signals naturally present during online interaction: environmental feedback following action execution. Recent theoretical studies suggest that generalization in multi-step, goal-oriented tasks hinges on predictive knowledge of environmental consequences. Inspired by this, we propose TAPO: Transition-Aware Policy Optimization for LLM Agents, a unified training framework that alternates between policy optimization and transition supervision. Beyond standard RL updates, TAPO repurposes rollout data to apply action-conditioned next-observation prediction supervision on a shared backbone model. This approach enhances the model's sensitivity to environmental transition dynamics and action consequences while concurrently optimizing the policy. It serves as a computationally lightweight, plug-and-play enhancement module for existing agent RL algorithms, requiring no additional expert data, extra sampling costs, or inference-time overhead. We conduct systematic experiments on WebShop and ALFWorld, integrating foundation models of various scales with different policy optimization algorithms. Empirical results demonstrate that TAPO consistently improves task performance over pure policy optimization baselines.

MMLDSum-LLM: Multimodal Long-Document Summarization with Visual-Alignment and Keyword-Aware

CategoryAreaReasoning, Agents, and Post-Training / Post-Training and AlignmentTopicreinforcement learning
Xianpeng Zhang, Jiahua Yang, Dongyu Chen, Lei zhang, Jian Ma, Xu guohuan et al.
high · 2026-07-30

Why it matters This paper gives multimodal long-document summarization both a dedicated benchmark and a reproducible training recipe: supervised fine-tuning uses visual-alignment and keyword-aware losses, followed by GRPO with rewards for keyword coverage, image-text alignment, summary quality, and length control. It is useful for researchers studying long-context multimodal post-training and hallucination reduction.

Source signalsarXiv indexed
Method brief
01
Problem

Multimodal LLMs can omit key evidence and produce cross-modal hallucinations when important content is sparse across long documents.

02
Method

The method applies supervised fine-tuning with visual-alignment and keyword-aware weighted losses, then applies GRPO with a multi-objective reward.

03
Difference

It trains against both content coverage and cross-modal consistency while introducing a benchmark spanning domains, context lengths, and visual-text distributions.

Abstract

Multimodal long documents are core carriers of professional knowledge, where critical evidence is sparsely distributed across paragraphs and modalities. This easily causes key information omission and cross-modal hallucinations in summarization by multimodal LLMs. These issues stem from attention drift in long-range dependency modeling and gaps in inter-modal alignment. To address this, we introduce MMLDSum-Bench, a high-quality benchmark for multimodal long-document summarization, covering multiple domains, context-length scales, and visual-textual modality distributions. We further propose MMLDSum-LLM, a reproducible two-stage training framework that combines supervised fine-tuning with visual-alignment weighted loss and keyword-aware weighted loss, followed by GRPO with a multi-objective reward (keyword coverage, image-text alignment, ROUGE, and length control). Extensive experiments on MMLDSum-Bench, comparing against leading closed-source and open-source multimodal models under a unified evaluation protocol - including LLM-as-a-judge scoring, atomic-claim precision/recall, image-text alignment (ITA), and ROUGE - demonstrate that our approach significantly improves key-information coverage and cross-modal consistency.

Batteries degrade, sensors drift, processors accumulate timing errors, and memory reliability declines, creating a growing mismatch between assumed and actual capability. By enabling machines to recognize and respond to their own aging, AAAI improves resilience, extends operational lifetime, and supports safer, more graceful mission completion.

OmegaUse-OfficeVal: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Office-Suite Tasks with Economic Grounding

Jingbo Zhou, Yusai Zhao, Qi Bao, Jingjia Cao, Zhenghai Chen, Chang Gao et al.
low · 2026-07-29

为什么值得看 它为代理系统的成本评估提供了比单纯准确率更接近实际部署的参照：可将推理成本与人工工时、任务价格代理直接比较。结果显示大语言模型代理虽然更快更便宜，但交付质量仍明显落后于人工，因此只优化推理成本不足以支持办公代理上线决策。

来源信号arXiv 收录Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 9）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

现有基准难以同时衡量办公套件代理的任务质量、执行成本和长期工作流能力。

02
方法

基准收集一百项办公套件任务，为每项任务配对人工工时和任务价格代理，并使用代码验证器依据细粒度评分标准判定结果。

03
差异

它把人工劳动成本和任务价格纳入任务级评测，而不只报告代理是否完成任务。

04
证据

任务平均需要二点三二小时人工完成，评测同时包含多个前沿大语言模型和人工基线，并报告模型更快更便宜但质量仍低于人工。

摘要

大语言模型代理正被用于协助用户完成任务，但现有基准很少评估代理能否以合理成本执行办公套件工作流。作者提出办公套件长流程任务基准，包含一百项来自实践者请求并经隐私保护处理的任务；每项任务都配有人力工时和任务价格代理两种经济信号，并通过依据细粒度评分标准构建的代码验证器支持稳定评测。评测表明，所有受测大语言模型都明显比人工更便宜、更快，但交付质量尚未接近人工水平；代码和数据均已开源。

A CPU+DCU Heterogeneous Parallel Framework for Post-Processing Reconstruction in Quantum Circuit Cutting

Qingqing Jiang, Weidong Liu, Yufu Liu, Ruiqing He, Jiandong Shang, Hengliang Guo et al.
low · 2026-07-30

为什么值得看 这项工作不直接服务人工智能训练或推理，但它展示了面向大规模组合重构的中央处理器与数据中心处理器协同、分层存储和超长索引设计；对处理稀疏结果、设备内存不足及超大状态空间的系统研究者有借鉴价值。实验在随机线路上较同质中央处理器并行方法最高加速四倍，在特定线性簇态上较优化串行基线最高加速二百五十九倍，并完成百量子比特规模重构。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

量子线路切割后的重构会随着线路规模、复杂度和切分数量增加而成为计算与存储瓶颈。

02
方法

框架使用中央处理器与数据中心处理器协同执行、非零状态重构、高低字整数索引和三级存储机制。

03
差异

它避免构造稠密的二的 n 次方维概率向量，也不只返回高概率状态。

04
证据

松山超算实验报告了线性簇态最高二百五十九倍加速、随机线路相对同质中央处理器并行最高四倍加速，并支持百量子比特规模。

摘要

在近中期量子计算时代，有限的量子比特资源使真实硬件难以直接执行大型量子线路。量子线路切割通过拆分线路缓解这一限制，却把大量开销转移到经典后处理中；本文提出一种中央处理器与数据中心处理器异构并行框架，通过重构原始输出分布中的非零概率状态、使用支持超过六十四位全局基态索引的高低字整数表示，并结合设备内存、主机内存和外存的三级协同存储，缓解重构的计算与存储瓶颈。

Wonder: Video World Model Done Better

Jiacong Xu, Hanwen Jiang, Zhixin Shu, Kalyan Sunkavalli, Vishal M. Patel, Yiqun Mei
low · 2026-07-28

为什么值得看 这项工作把可控视频生成中的记忆检索、相机控制和蒸馏训练作为一个系统共同设计，尤其值得关注的是其稀疏注意力记忆机制：推理时只访问少量相关上下文标记，而不随生成历史长度线性扩大注意范围。它对研究长时视频生成和实时交互式推理的人员有参考价值，但论文重点仍是世界模型能力，不是通用推理服务或基础设施。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 18）
方法解读
01
问题

模型需要在长时间视频生成中同时理解相机控制、检索历史上下文并保持场景一致性。

02
方法

系统使用带稠密坐标场的相机条件、稀疏注意力记忆和经过修正的自强制式蒸馏流程。

03
差异

记忆模块在推理时选择少量相关上下文标记，而不是让注意力覆盖全部生成历史。

04
证据

论文声称系统能以每秒十六帧生成分钟级视频，并保持长期滚动中的几何、外观和动态一致性。

摘要

本文提出了Wonder，一种面向实时、可控相机世界探索的通用视频世界模型。它从图像或条件视频构建可交互的可玩世界，使用户能够移动相机、发现未见区域并回访已观察区域；模型结合稠密坐标场相机条件、稀疏注意力记忆机制和改进的自强制蒸馏流程，在每秒十六帧下生成分钟级视频，同时保持长时间滚动过程中的几何、外观和动态一致性，并支持对已有动态场景进行实时重新拍摄。

ESBT: A Scalable and Deterministic Sequence CRDT for Distributed Collaborative Editing

Moulay Driss Mechaoui, Abdessamad Imine
low · 2026-07-30

为什么值得看 这项工作主要解决分布式协同编辑中的序列冲突无关数据类型扩展问题，对人工智能基础设施的直接价值有限；其可借鉴之处是用确定性、紧凑的标识符分配降低长期并发会话中的内存增长和更新开销。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

现有序列冲突无关数据类型在长期高并发编辑中会出现标识符失控增长和内存持续增加。

02
方法

方法使用扩展斯特恩—布罗科特树分配具有稠密性、确定性和紧凑性的序列标识符。

03
差异

该设计在保持强最终一致性和确定性顺序的同时，对标识符增长进行约束。

04
证据

在五十个站点和十万次并发操作的工作负载上，论文报告响应性提升百分之二十八至百分之八十八，并在部分模式下将标识符内存降低百分之五十至百分之七十五。

摘要

现代协同编辑系统需要高效机制来管理分布式副本之间的并发更新。论文提出扩展斯特恩—布罗科特树，通过稠密、确定且紧凑的标识符空间限制标识符增长，同时保持确定性排序和强最终一致性；在最多五十个协作站点生成十万次并发操作的实验中，相比洛古特和莱斯序列冲突无关数据类型，系统在多种插入与删除负载下提升响应性并减少标识符内存消耗。

CADENCE: Closing the Reasoning Gap via Coverage-Adaptive On-Policy Distillation

Satyam Kumar, Saurabh Jha
low · 2026-07-18

为什么值得看 这项工作主要改进推理蒸馏算法，而不是训练系统、集群、编译器或推理基础设施；它对需要在单台消费级设备上训练小模型的研究者有一定参考价值，但对人工智能基础设施设计的直接启发有限。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 4）
方法解读
01
问题

学生模型可能无法覆盖教师偏好的词元，且时间驱动的散度调度和二值奖励会损失训练信号。

02
方法

方法在学生采样轨迹上使用按词元的正向散度与反向散度混合目标，并加入覆盖度调度、分叉词元增强、部分奖励和自蒸馏等机制。

03
差异

它根据学生的覆盖状态而非仅按训练时间切换散度，并利用数值接近度为错误轨迹提供稠密反馈。

04
证据

在两个数学推理数据集、五个随机种子和修正的五百一十二词元协议下，五亿参数学生模型达到百分之六十九点八的通过率，并较匹配计算量基线提高四点四个百分点。

摘要

在策略上知识蒸馏中，现有方法面临冷启动崩溃、忽略学生覆盖状态的散度调度，以及将部分正确轨迹压缩为成败信号三类问题。该方法通过按词元混合正向与反向散度、覆盖度自适应调度、熵引导梯度、稠密部分奖励、偏好简洁答案的强化、熵匹配校准和自蒸馏等组件加以处理；在两个数学推理基准上，将五亿参数学生模型的通过率从百分之四十八点七提高到百分之六十九点八，并声称优于匹配计算量的基线。

Secure Aggregation for Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning on Clinical EEG Data

Pouya Rajabi, Mohsen Toorani
low · 2026-07-30

为什么值得看 这项工作对关注跨机构训练的基础设施研究者有一定参考价值：它把安全聚合、掉线容错、恶意服务器防护和可验证性整合到联邦学习实现中，并明确展示了更强隐私与完整性保障会增加通信、计算和训练轮次时长开销；但其核心场景是临床脑电隐私，而不是通用训练系统优化。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

联邦学习中的聚合服务器可能从单个客户端模型更新中推断隐私信息。

02
方法

框架使用掩码安全聚合，并加入图通信、门限秘密共享、抗掉线机制、更新裁剪和辅助公证方验证。

03
差异

它同时覆盖半诚实与恶意聚合者，并把隐私保护记录链接作为可选初始化模块。

04
证据

基于花框架和某临床脑电数据集的跨机构模拟显示，半诚实配置开销最低，而恶意与公证方配置提供更强一致性和完整性支持但耗费更高。

摘要

联邦学习允许多家机构在不交换原始临床脑电数据的情况下训练共享模型，但单个模型更新仍可能泄露隐私。本文基于掩码安全聚合构建面向临床脑电数据的隐私保护联邦学习框架，并结合图通信、门限秘密共享、抗掉线聚合、本地更新裁剪、可选的隐私保护记录链接初始化模块和辅助公证方可验证机制；在模拟的跨机构医疗环境中评估了不同安全配置，结果表明安全版本仍可支持联邦模型训练，但恶意场景防护和一致性检查会带来额外开销。

论文 / 补充信号

Minimal Markovization via Stable Quotients in Holonomy-Cover Decision Processes

Zuyuan Zhang, Yongshan Chen, Mahdi Imani, Tian Lan
low · 2026-07-29

为什么值得看 这项工作主要是部分可观测强化学习的理论研究，而不是训练系统、推理服务或运行时基础设施。它对人工智能基础设施研究者的直接价值有限，但其中的稳定商和记忆压缩结果可能为需要有限状态控制器的强化学习系统提供状态表示依据。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

部分可观测环境通常需要递归更新历史统计量，但最小的马尔可夫记忆大小通常未知。

02
方法

方法构造稳定商，用当前观测和稳定类作为状态，并通过有序边传输更新类别。

03
差异

它不仅给出有限记忆表示，还在可达性和决策区分条件下证明该表示所需的记忆符号数达到下界。

04
证据

实验将原始状态精确压缩为商状态，并用三个决策时刻记忆状态达到完美的成对顺序准确率。

摘要

OmegaUse-OfficeVal: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Office-Suite Tasks with Economic Grounding

Jingbo Zhou, Yusai Zhao, Qi Bao, Jingjia Cao, Zhenghai Chen, Chang Gao et al.
low · 2026-07-29

Why it matters The benchmark gives agent-serving teams a deployment-relevant way to compare inference cost with human labor time and task-price proxies, rather than optimizing quality in isolation. Its result is a warning for capacity planning: agents are faster and cheaper, but their deliverable quality still trails humans, so lower serving cost alone does not establish business viability.

Source signalsarXiv indexedHugging Face Daily Papers (community upvotes 👍 9)
Code
Method brief
01
Problem

Existing benchmarks do not adequately measure whether agents can complete long office-suite workflows at an economically reasonable cost.

02
Method

It packages 100 practitioner-derived tasks with human labor time, a task-price proxy, and code-based verifiers built from fine-grained rubrics.

03
Difference

The evaluation makes economic signals part of the task-level score and directly compares human costs with LLM inference costs.

04
Evidence

The tasks require 2.32 hours of human labor on average, and experiments compare several frontier LLMs with a human baseline while finding lower speed and cost but weaker deliverable quality for the models.

Abstract

Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly expected to assist users in completing tasks. However, existing benchmarks provide limited support for evaluating whether agents can carry out office-suite workflows at a reasonable cost. We introduce OmegaUse-OfficeVal, a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on long-horizon office-suite tasks with task-level economic grounding. The benchmark comprises 100 tasks derived from office-suite requests proposed by practitioners and adapted through a privacy-preserving process. On average, these tasks require 2.32 hours of human labor to complete. An important feature of the benchmark is that each task is paired with two economic signals: human labor time and task price proxy. These signals enable direct comparisons between human costs and LLM inference costs, as well as value-weighted evaluation. To support stable evaluation, we develop code-based verifiers from fine-grained rubrics. We evaluate several frontier LLMs together with a human baseline. Although all evaluated LLMs are substantially cheaper and faster than human workers, they have not yet approached human-level deliverable quality. The code and dataset are fully open-sourced, and more information is available on our project website: https://omegause-officeval.github.io.

A CPU+DCU Heterogeneous Parallel Framework for Post-Processing Reconstruction in Quantum Circuit Cutting

Qingqing Jiang, Weidong Liu, Yufu Liu, Ruiqing He, Jiandong Shang, Hengliang Guo et al.
low · 2026-07-30

Why it matters This is not directly an AI training or serving paper, but it offers an adjacent HPC design for large combinatorial reconstruction: CPU+DCU cooperation, multi-tier storage, and indices beyond 64 bits. The reported gains reach 259× over an optimized serial baseline for linear-cluster states and 4× over homogeneous CPU parallelism for random circuits, with reconstruction completed at the hundred-qubit scale.

Source signalsarXiv indexed
Method brief
01
Problem

Post-processing after quantum circuit cutting becomes a compute and storage bottleneck as circuit size, complexity, and cut count grow.

02
Method

The framework combines CPU+DCU execution, nonzero-state reconstruction, high/low-word integer indices, and device-host-out-of-core storage.

03
Difference

It avoids building a dense 2^n probability vector and does not restrict output to only high-probability states.

04
Evidence

Experiments on the Songshan supercomputer report up to 259× speedup for linear-cluster states, up to 4× over homogeneous CPU parallelism for random circuits, and support for hundred-qubit reconstruction.

Abstract

In the NISQ era, limited qubit resources make it difficult to execute large quantum circuits directly on real hardware. Quantum circuit cutting mitigates this limitation by decomposing a large circuit into smaller subcircuits, but it shifts substantial overhead to classical post-processing. As circuit size, complexity, and cut count increase, reconstruction becomes a major computational and storage bottleneck. This paper presents a CPU+DCU heterogeneous parallel framework for circuit-cutting post-processing reconstruction. Instead of constructing a dense $2^n$-dimensional probability vector or returning only high-probability states, the framework reconstructs the nonzero-probability states in the original output distribution from subcircuit measurement results. It combines heterogeneous CPU+DCU execution with a high/low-word integer representation for global basis-state indices beyond 64 bits and a three-level cooperative storage mechanism spanning device memory, host memory, and out-of-core storage. Experiments on the Songshan supercomputer show that the framework maintains high reconstruction fidelity while achieving up to $259\times$ speedup over an optimized serial baseline on linear-cluster states and up to $4\times$ speedup over a homogeneous CPU-parallel method on random circuits. The framework can also complete reconstruction tasks at the hundred-qubit scale. These results demonstrate that HPC-oriented heterogeneous reconstruction can effectively alleviate the classical post-processing bottleneck and improve reconstruction scalability.

Wonder: Video World Model Done Better

Jiacong Xu, Hanwen Jiang, Zhixin Shu, Kalyan Sunkavalli, Vishal M. Patel, Yiqun Mei
low · 2026-07-28

Why it matters Wonder treats camera control, memory retrieval, and distillation as one system design problem for interactive video generation. Its sparse attention memory is relevant to long-horizon inference because it attends to a small set of relevant context tokens instead of scaling attention over the full generation history. The paper is useful for researchers studying real-time generative world models, but it is not primarily an AI infrastructure or serving-systems paper.

Source signalsHugging Face Daily Papers (community upvotes 👍 18)
Method brief
01
Problem

The model must follow camera controls, retrieve useful history, and preserve scene consistency during long video rollouts.

02
Method

The system combines dense-coordinate-field camera conditioning, sparse attention memory, and a corrected self-forcing-style distillation pipeline.

03
Difference

The memory module selects a small number of relevant context tokens at inference time rather than attending over the entire generated history.

04
Evidence

The paper claims minute-scale generation at 16 FPS while preserving coherent geometry, appearance, and dynamics over long rollouts.

Abstract

We present Wonder, a general-purpose video world model for real-time, camera-controllable world exploration. Given an image or a conditional video, Wonder constructs a playable world where users can navigate interactively by moving the camera, discovering unseen regions, and revisiting previously observed areas in real time and over a long-term horizon. Achieving this capability requires a system-level co-design of control method, memory mechanism, and training strategy. We introduce a novel camera conditioning with a dense coordinate field whose renderings provide spatially aligned motion and orientation cues, allowing the model to interpret camera motion directly as visual evidence. To support fast and precise memory retrieval over a growing generation context, we propose an efficient sparse attention-based memory mechanism, enabling the model to selectively attend to a small set of relevant context tokens at inference time, regardless of actual context length. We further develop several techniques to rectify the self-forcing-style distillation pipeline, improving the student model's ability to respect control signals, as well as maintaining diverse generation modes and long-term memory from the teacher. Together, these components enable Wonder to synthesize diverse, minute-scale videos at 16 FPS while preserving coherent geometry, appearance, and dynamics across long rollouts. Beyond image-to-video generation, Wonder naturally supports video-conditioned generation, allowing existing dynamic scenes to be re-shot in real time.

ESBT: A Scalable and Deterministic Sequence CRDT for Distributed Collaborative Editing

Moulay Driss Mechaoui, Abdessamad Imine
low · 2026-07-30

Why it matters This paper is mainly about distributed collaborative editing rather than AI infrastructure, so its direct relevance is limited; the transferable systems idea is deterministic, compact identifier allocation that curbs memory growth in long-running, highly concurrent sessions.

Source signalsarXiv indexed
Method brief
01
Problem

Existing sequence CRDTs can suffer uncontrolled identifier growth and rising memory use during prolonged concurrent editing.

02
Method

ESBT allocates sequence identifiers through an Extended Stern-Brocot Tree to provide a dense, deterministic, and compact identifier space.

03
Difference

The scheme bounds identifier growth while retaining deterministic ordering and Strong Eventual Consistency.

04
Evidence

Across workloads with 50 sites and up to 100,000 concurrent operations, the paper reports 28–88% responsiveness gains and 50–75% lower identifier memory in selected patterns.

Abstract

Modern collaborative editing systems require efficient mechanisms for managing concurrent updates across distributed replicas. Sequence Conflict-free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs) have become the de facto standard for supporting decentralized collaboration; they enable decentralized replicas to apply operations in arbitrary order while converging to a common state. Although existing sequence CRDTs guarantee Strong Eventual Consistency (SEC), they often suffer from uncontrolled identifier growth and increasing memory consumption during long-running, highly concurrent editing sessions, which severely limits their scalability and performance. This paper presents the Extended Stern-Brocot Tree (ESBT), a mathematically grounded identifier allocation scheme for distributed collaborative text editing, providing a dense, deterministic, and compact identifier space. The proposed allocation strategy bounds identifier growth while preserving deterministic ordering and Strong Eventual Consistency. Experimental evaluation using workloads of up to 100,000 concurrent operations generated across 50 collaborating sites shows that ESBT improves responsiveness by 28 to 88% under pure insertions and 59 to 74% under mixed insertion/deletion workloads, while reducing identifier memory consumption by 50 to 75% in beginning and random insertion patterns compared with the best-performing baseline sequence CRDTs (Logoot and LSEQ). Under the adversarial middle-insertion workload (10,000 operations), ESBT further improves responsiveness by 86.53% and reduces identifier size by 92.81%. These results demonstrate that ESBT effectively addresses the principal scalability limitations of existing sequence CRDTs and provides an efficient and scalable foundation for large-scale collaborative editing systems.

CADENCE: Closing the Reasoning Gap via Coverage-Adaptive On-Policy Distillation

Satyam Kumar, Saurabh Jha
low · 2026-07-18

Why it matters This paper mainly improves reasoning-distillation algorithms rather than training systems, clusters, compilers, or serving infrastructure. It may help researchers training compact models on a single consumer device, but it offers limited direct guidance for AI-infrastructure design.

Source signalsHugging Face Daily Papers (community upvotes 👍 4)
Method brief
01
Problem

Students may assign little probability to teacher-preferred tokens, while time-based divergence schedules and binary rewards discard useful training signal.

02
Method

The method applies per-token mixtures of forward and reverse KL objectives on student-sampled trajectories, with coverage scheduling, forking-token emphasis, partial rewards, and self-distillation.

03
Difference

It switches the divergence schedule according to student coverage rather than training time alone and gives dense credit to incorrect traces that are numerically close.

04
Evidence

Across two mathematical reasoning benchmarks, five seeds, and a corrected 512-token protocol, the 0.5B student reaches 69.8% pass@1 and improves over the matched-compute baseline by 4.4 points.

Abstract

On-policy knowledge distillation transfers reasoning from large teachers to compact students, but existing approaches suffer three compounding failure modes: (i) cold-start collapse, where a fresh student assigns near-zero mass to teacher-preferred tokens; (ii) state-agnostic divergence scheduling, where time-only forward/reverse-KL interpolation ignores the student's coverage state; and (iii) binary reward sparsity, where pass/fail signals discard information from partially correct traces. We present CADENCE, a unified framework with a targeted fix for each. Its DRIFT mechanism schedules a per-token convex mixture of forward-KL and reverse-KL surrogate objectives on student-sampled trajectories (per-token surrogates, not sequence-level KL gradient estimators). Six components extend it: (A) COVA, a coverage-adaptive β schedule accelerating the forward-to-reverse transition; (B) FTB, a forking-token boost concentrating gradient at high-entropy positions via a globally-normalized entropy reference; (C) CCD, a dense reward adding numerical-proximity partial credit for incorrect-but-close traces; (D) LAP, brevity-preferential correct-rollout reinforcement; (E) EMR, an entropy-matching calibration regularizer; (F) BSD, a bootstrapped self-distillation phase. On GSM8K and MATH-500 (corrected 512-token protocol, 5 seeds, reported std), CADENCE distills a 0.5B student from a 1.5B teacher to 69.8 pm 0.5% GSM8K pass@1 (from 48.7% pretrained; 63.2% of the teacher gap closed) and to 72.1 pm 0.4% with a 3B teacher (76.2% closed), beating the strongest matched-compute label-using baseline (DRIFT+binary reward) by +4.4 pm 0.7 points. All experiments run on a single Apple Mac Studio (M-series, 64GB unified memory), showing principled distillation reaches strong reasoning quality without datacenter-scale hardware.

Secure Aggregation for Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning on Clinical EEG Data

Pouya Rajabi, Mohsen Toorani
low · 2026-07-30

Why it matters For researchers building cross-silo training infrastructure, this paper shows how secure aggregation, dropout tolerance, malicious-server safeguards, and verifiability can coexist in a federated implementation, while making the systems cost explicit: stronger protection increases computation, communication, and round duration. Its main focus is clinical EEG privacy rather than general training-system performance.

Source signalsarXiv indexed
Method brief
01
Problem

A federated server may infer private information from individual client updates even when raw clinical data stays local.

02
Method

The framework uses masking-based secure aggregation with graph communication, threshold secret sharing, dropout resilience, update clipping, and auxiliary-notary verification.

03
Difference

It supports both semi-honest and malicious aggregation settings and optionally initializes privacy-preserving record linkage with a Bloom filter.

04
Evidence

Abstract

Federated learning enables multiple institutions to train shared models without exchanging raw clinical EEG data, but it does not fully prevent privacy leakage from individual model updates. This paper presents a privacy-preserving federated learning framework for clinical EEG data using masking-based secure aggregation as the core protection mechanism. The framework combines graph-based communication, threshold secret sharing, dropout-resilient aggregation, local update clipping, an optional Bloom filter-based privacy-preserving record-linkage initialization module, and auxiliary-notary-based verifiability. It supports both semi-honest and malicious aggregation settings and is implemented using the Flower federated learning framework. The secure-aggregation variants are evaluated in a simulated cross-silo healthcare setting using TUH EEG-derived data under different client configurations. Under the stated assumptions, the secure variants hide individual updates from the aggregation server. The results show that these variants remain compatible with federated model training, although malicious-setting safeguards and lightweight consistency-checking mechanisms introduce additional computation, communication, and round-duration overhead. The semi-honest variant provides the lowest overhead among the secure configurations, while malicious and auxiliary-notary variants offer stronger consistency, integrity, and lightweight verification support at higher cost.

Minimal Markovization via Stable Quotients in Holonomy-Cover Decision Processes

Zuyuan Zhang, Yongshan Chen, Mahdi Imani, Tian Lan
low · 2026-07-29

Why it matters This is primarily a theory result for partially observable reinforcement learning, not a contribution to training systems, serving, runtimes, or cluster infrastructure. Its direct value for AI-infrastructure researchers is therefore limited, although the stable-quotient construction could inform compact state representations for RL controllers with finite memory.

Source signalsarXiv indexed
Method brief
01
Problem

Partially observable environments require a recursively updated history statistic, while the minimum memory size is generally unknown.

02
Method

The method constructs a stable quotient, uses the current observation and quotient class as the state, and updates the class through ordered edge transports.

03
Difference

It proves both exact finite-state Markovization and a lower bound showing that the required memory symbols cannot be reduced under reachability and decision-separation assumptions.

04
Evidence

Abstract

An agent acting under partial observability must retain a recursively updateable statistic of history that restores the Markov property, but the smallest such statistic is generally unknown. We characterize this minimal Markov sufficient statistic for holonomy-cover decision processes, a structured POMDP class in which the visible dynamics are Markov and every realized visible transition applies a fixed permutation to a hidden mode. In particular, we construct the stable quotient, the coarsest observation-wise abstraction preserving one-step rewards and quotient successors, and prove that the pair of the current observation and stable class forms an exact finite Markov state. When the current class is correctly initialized, exact class tracking requires exactly the minimal memory symbols, in the sense that under reachability and pairwise decision separation at a maximizing observation, no arbitrary finite-memory controller can use fewer. Under resettable diagnostics, nearest-prototype class inference has exponentially decaying error, and a calibrate-then-restart reduction transfers finite-MDP guarantees to the recovered state. The results enable \emph{Holonomy Memory Reinforcement Learning}. It represents memory by the current stable class, updates it through ordered edge transports, identifies local class coordinates when diagnostics are available, and applies a standard finite-MDP RL backbone after synchronization. Experiments recover an exact compression from raw states to quotient states and achieve perfect paired-order accuracy with three decision-time memory states, matching the quotient oracle and outperforming the non-oracle baselines.

llm-agents.body:
01 / 论文

📄 论文

主题reasoning / planning

01
论文 / 高优先级

ARES: Adaptive Reasoning-Effort Steering for PPA- and Cost-Aware RTL Optimization with LLM Agents

分类主题reasoning / planning
Stef Cuyckens, Mihaela Jivanescu, Jun Yin, Chao Fang, Marian Verhelst
high · 2026-07-30

为什么值得看 它说明代理优化硬件时不必让每次调用都使用最高推理强度，而应在低强度迭代停滞后再升级，从而在相同成本下把推理预算集中到真正有收益的步骤。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

现有代理通常不报告达到优化质量所需的归一化调用成本，并固定每次调用的推理强度。

02
方法

方法同时记录每次大语言模型调用的美元成本，比较工程化长期记忆与经验直接拼接，并用在二十一个训练设计上拟合的耐心计数器按进展动态提升推理强度。

03
差异

它用停滞触发的推理升级替代全程固定强度，并发现复杂跨设计记忆相较于相同经验的直接拼接没有可靠收益。

04
证据

在三个未参与训练的测试设计上，相同归一化成本下其评价指标降低百分之二十三至二十七，而最佳固定强度仅降低百分之十六至二十三；相较人工优化结果最多缩小百分之八十三的差距，并以百分之十二的词元量达到比现有方法高百分之二十五的评价指标。

摘要

论文研究用大语言模型代理通过反复编辑、综合和功耗性能面积分析来优化寄存器传输级设计，并指出既有工作缺少归一化成本报告、过度强调工程化跨设计记忆且固定每次调用的推理强度。该方法引入调用成本核算，发现复杂记忆没有可靠优势，随后利用耐心计数器在低强度进展停滞后升级推理；在三个未见测试设计上，它以相同成本取得百分之二十三至二十七的评价指标下降，并在较低词元量下超过现有方法。

潜力 34新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号
5 位作者1 所机构4 条合作线
02
论文 / 高优先级

DeepResearch Agent System

分类主题reasoning / planning
Yong Huang, Yulu Huang, for the team Collaboration
high · 2026-07-30

为什么值得看 它把检索、网页搜索、计算和文件解析接入可迭代的多步研究流程，并声称在多项搜索代理基准上取得较高成绩，同时以稀疏激活降低推理成本，值得关注于需要长上下文、多工具协作和持续推理的研究代理开发者。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

系统面向深度信息检索、多步推理和自主研究任务，处理长上下文与多工具协同。

02
方法

它结合三百亿总参数但每个词仅激活三十亿参数的稀疏架构、分层注意力、两种推理模式、多工具协调和基于策略梯度的强化学习。

03
差异

相较单次推理和标准长上下文方法，它支持最多二十步迭代研究，并将检索、计算、网页搜索和文件解析放入统一流程。

04
证据

摘要声称其工具使用准确率为百分之九十二点一，在三项代理搜索基准上分别达到百分之八十七点三、百分之八十五点三和百分之九十一点二。

摘要

该系统面向深度信息检索、多步推理和自主研究任务，采用稀疏激活架构、十二万八千词上下文窗口及分层注意力，并结合基础多步推理与最多二十步的迭代研究模式。摘要声称它相较同规模稠密模型推理速度提升三点二倍，相较标准长上下文方法准确率和召回率分别提升百分之十八点七和百分之二十三点四，相较单次推理基线准确率提升百分之三十一点二，并在多项代理搜索基准、工具使用、训练稳定性和收敛速度上取得所列结果。

潜力 33新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号
3 位作者1 所机构2 条合作线
03
论文 / 高优先级

Contrastive Reinforced Policy Optimization via Privileged Self-Distillation

分类主题reasoning / planning
Xingjian Wu, Junlin Liu, Xingchen Liu, Xuhang Zhu, Jianing Wang, Linsen Guo et al.
high · 2026-07-30

为什么值得看 它针对多轮智能体推理中的暴露偏差和推理路径收敛，用对比式位置筛选保留更细粒度的探索信号，可能改善长程交互训练的稳定性与泛化能力。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

现有在线自蒸馏依赖教师可见的特权信息，导致暴露偏差、推理路线收敛和优化方向变弱。

02
方法

方法利用预测熵区分反思探索位置与暴露偏差位置，并在组内进行对比优化。

03
差异

它把智能体在线自蒸馏重新表述为对比学习，而不是只使用教师提供的密集逐标记监督。

04
证据

论文在十三个推理与深度搜索基准上报告了相较强化学习和自蒸馏基线更稳定且更强的泛化表现。

摘要

近年来，大语言模型的后训练越来越依赖带可验证奖励的强化学习和在线自蒸馏，但后者因教师拥有特权信息而产生暴露偏差，在多轮智能体场景中还会造成推理路线收敛。论文提出对比式强化策略优化，通过预测熵区分反思探索位置与暴露偏差位置，并进行组内对比学习，以保留可靠且细粒度的优化信号；在十三个推理和深度搜索基准上的评测显示，该方法提升了长程交互训练的稳定性和泛化能力。

潜力 30新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号
9 位作者0 所机构8 条合作线

主题tool use / function calling

04
论文 / 高优先级

FaithEyes: Towards Faithful Tool Use via Multi-Agent Process-Image Verification

分类主题tool use / function calling
Haoqing Wang, Xingrun Xing, Wei Xia, Ziheng Li, Yehui Tang
high · 2026-07-30

为什么值得看 它把工具调用是否真正提供了证据纳入反馈和奖励，既能压制视觉智能体的装饰性调用与奖励投机，又能在推理时由模型内部完成判断，适合关注工具忠实性和训练部署一致性的研究者。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

视觉语言智能体可能调用了错误或无关的图像工具，却仍获得完整奖励并依靠原图或先验知识答对。

02
方法

系统让视觉语言模型判断每张过程图是否有助于回答问题，并将判断写入工具观察，同时用有用工具比例缩放工具奖励。

03
差异

多智能体结构让模型自身作为子智能体检查主智能体的调用，因此评估阶段不依赖外部判断模型并保持训练与测试一致。

04
证据

在改造的开源数据上采用两阶段监督微调加强化学习训练后，作者称其在视觉感知和推理基准上取得有竞争力或更高的准确率，并显著提升工具忠实性。

摘要

面向视觉语言智能体不忠实使用裁剪和代码图像处理等工具的问题，本文指出许多过程图与问题无关，但调用仍获满分，导致计算浪费并掩盖模型对原图或先验知识的依赖。FaithEyes使用视觉语言模型判断过程图是否有帮助，将该判断注入后续推理并按有用工具比例调整奖励；通过多智能体自判断结构，它在评估时无需外部模型，据称在多个视觉感知与推理基准上保持有竞争力或更高的准确率，同时明显改善工具忠实性。

潜力 40新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号
5 位作者2 所机构4 条合作线
05
论文 / 高优先级

Vibe-FDTR: An agent-oriented framework for reproducible frequency-domain thermoreflectance data analysis

分类主题tool use / function calling
Fuwei Yang, Weiheng Li, Bai Song
high · 2026-07-30

为什么值得看 它显示把领域代码的物理与参数约束、可验证操作技能嵌入大语言模型代理，能将复杂热计量分析从依赖专家的编程流程变成可复现的自然语言任务，并在真实多步骤数据上达到百分之九十八点九的成功率且显著降低计算与执行成本。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

频域热反射数据分析步骤复杂，需要较多领域知识，也容易因细微人为错误而失效。

02
方法

系统将配置驱动的频域热反射代码包与把用户意图转成有组织且可核验步骤的代理技能结合起来。

03
差异

相较仅使用代码代理或仅使用大语言模型代理，它同时封装了物理约束、参数一致性和领域操作流程。

04
证据

在合成单步任务和真实金涂层石墨多步骤任务上，系统成功率分别为百分之百和百分之九十八点九，并较代码代理变体降低百分之八十七点七的计算成本。

摘要

论文提出面向代理的频域热反射分析框架，使大语言模型代理能够根据自然语言请求执行可靠且可复现的热性质分析。该框架结合强制物理与参数一致性的配置驱动代码包，以及将用户意图转化为有组织、可验证分析步骤的程序化技能；在合成单步任务和真实数据多步骤任务上分别取得百分之百和百分之九十八点九的成功率，并支持通过自主灵敏度与不确定性评估辅助实验规划。

潜力 41新颖度workload开源度洞见呈现机构信号
3 位作者1 所机构2 条合作线

主题agent safety / robustness

06
论文 / 高优先级

LEDGERMIND: Provenance-Constrained Multimodal Agentic Reasoning with a Structured Evidence Ledger

分类主题agent safety / robustness
Enjun Du, Hange Zhou, Chenxu Du, Siyi Liu, Zirong Chen, Ziyu Zheng et al.
high · 2026-07-30

为什么值得看 它把多模态智能体的工具证据、推理引用和修复过程约束在可追溯账本中，使研究者不再只看最终答对率，而能定位无依据推理、实体幻觉和修复放大等轨迹级失效。

来源信号arXiv 收录Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 10）
方法解读
01
问题

现有多模态智能体评测主要看最终答案，无法区分证据支撑的推理、语言先验和偶然的错误抵消。

02
方法

该方法将工具输出规范化为结构化证据账本，并通过三层落地协议、自适应双路径调度器和事件触发的验证修复引擎控制轨迹状态转移。

03
差异

后续推理和决策只能引用账本中的活动条目，实体与数值落地检查以及修复转移不得引入缺少工具来源的新内容。

04
证据

差异

相较仅使用代码代理或仅使用大语言模型代理，它同时封装了物理约束、参数一致性和领域操作流程。

04
证据

在合成单步任务和真实金涂层石墨多步骤任务上，系统成功率分别为百分之百和百分之九十八点九，并较代码代理变体降低百分之八十七点七的计算成本。

摘要

论文提出面向代理的频域热反射分析框架，使大语言模型代理能够根据自然语言请求执行可靠且可复现的热性质分析。该框架结合强制物理与参数一致性的配置驱动代码包，以及将用户意图转化为有组织、可验证分析步骤的程序化技能；在合成单步任务和真实数据多步骤任务上分别取得百分之百和百分之九十八点九的成功率，并支持通过自主灵敏度与不确定性评估辅助实验规划。

LEDGERMIND: Provenance-Constrained Multimodal Agentic Reasoning with a Structured Evidence Ledger

分类主题agent safety / robustness
Enjun Du, Hange Zhou, Chenxu Du, Siyi Liu, Zirong Chen, Ziyu Zheng et al.
high · 2026-07-30

为什么值得看 它把多模态智能体的工具证据、推理引用和修复过程约束在可追溯账本中，使研究者不再只看最终答对率，而能定位无依据推理、实体幻觉和修复放大等轨迹级失效。

来源信号arXiv 收录Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 10）
方法解读
01
问题

现有多模态智能体评测主要看最终答案，无法区分证据支撑的推理、语言先验和偶然的错误抵消。

02
方法

该方法将工具输出规范化为结构化证据账本，并通过三层落地协议、自适应双路径调度器和事件触发的验证修复引擎控制轨迹状态转移。

03
差异

后续推理和决策只能引用账本中的活动条目，实体与数值落地检查以及修复转移不得引入缺少工具来源的新内容。

04
证据

论文在多个多模态推理基准和多种多模态大模型上报告了答案准确率与轨迹级忠实度同时提升。

摘要

多模态智能体在视觉问答中会交错执行感知、检索和推理，但最终答案准确率无法揭示答案是否由有依据的证据、语言先验或偶然的错误抵消产生。论文把智能体轨迹建模为受来源约束的状态机，以结构化证据账本保存工具输出，并通过受限引用、实体与数值级落地检查及类型化修复转移，针对无依据中间推理、带引用的实体幻觉、简单问题上的过度推理和修复放大等失效模式；在多个基准上，账本思维系统被报告为同时改善答案准确率和轨迹忠实度。

ClawTrack: Towards Trace-Level Evaluation and Improvement of Real-World Autonomous Agents

分类主题agent evaluation / benchmarks

high · 2026-07-30

为什么值得看 它把长程智能体评估从只看最终成败推进到逐步诊断，可识别侥幸成功、定位推理缺陷，并用轨迹筛选稳定改善不同规模模型的后训练。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

现有基准主要依据最终结果评分，无法区分可靠推理与侥幸成功，也难以归因长程任务中的具体失败。

02
方法

基准包含八个领域的三百二十项任务和二十五个以上确定性模拟服务，并用过程评分器按目标一致性、效率、信息利用和结果验证评估每个推理回合。

03
差异

它同时衡量任务完成结果和完成过程，并以一万二千五百四十一条任务专属量规支撑过程评分。

04
证据

对二十一种模型开展超过一万六千次试验显示，过程评分能归因成败、揭示结果验证是系统性瓶颈，且轨迹筛选可带来持续的后训练改进。

摘要

论文提出一种双重评估基准，同时衡量智能体完成了什么以及如何完成；该基准覆盖八个领域的三百二十项任务，并用过程评分器从四个维度评估每个推理回合。对二十一种模型和超过一万六千次试验的结果表明，过程评分能够过滤最终结果评估无法发现的侥幸成功、稳定识别结果验证瓶颈，并支持通过轨迹筛选改进不同规模模型的后训练。

Rethinking Inference-Time Scaling in Local Computer-Use Agents: Failure Modes and Compute Tradeoffs

分类主题GUI / computer-use agents

high · 2026-07-30

为什么值得看 它表明本地计算机使用智能体不能靠盲目增加推理计算来稳定提升成功率，而应根据失败类型选择性分配上下文、时间、结构化分解和并行计算，这直接关系到隐私受限或硬件受限部署的成本与可靠性。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

论文研究资源受限的本地计算机使用智能体是否能从执行时增加计算中稳定获益。

02
方法

作者在操作系统世界基准上，系统评估三类本地模型在上下文、时间、结构和并行维度上的推理时扩展。

03
差异

研究不只比较成功率，还分析额外计算如何改变重复停滞、过早误判成功和错误轨迹延长等失败模式。

04
证据

结果显示上下文扩展能改善轨迹稳定性但收益会饱和，时间扩展减少步数停滞却未明显提高任务成功率，结构分解会增加规划与格式开销，而并行扩展需要较高计算成本。

摘要

本文系统研究资源受限本地计算机使用智能体的推理时扩展，覆盖上下文、时间、结构和并行四个维度，并在操作系统世界基准上评估三种本地模型。结果表明，额外计算经常带来递减收益并改变失败模式：上下文扩展可通过历史信息改善轨迹稳定性和任务准确率但会饱和，时间扩展虽减少最大步数停滞却难以提升成功率，结构分解可能增加规划与格式开销，而并行扩展能部分缓解失败但代价较高。

01 / 论文

📄 论文

主题embodied agents

01
论文 / 高优先级

ODEWorld: A Continuous Predictive Architecture via Physical-Time Flow

分类主题embodied agents
Dongxiu Liu, Haoyi Niu, Peng Cheng, Yuan Gao, Xirui Kang, Sangli Teng et al.
high · 2026-07-30

为什么值得看 它把机器人世界模型从固定步长预测改成可任意调节时间分辨率的连续动力学，并支持长时规划与反向推演，可能减少离散预测在控制和视觉逼真度之间的取舍。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

现有世界模型多用离散时间预测，难以高效表示物理世界的连续动态并避免长时潜表示坍塌。

02
方法

方法学习物理时间中的连续潜速度场，并用嵌入表示空间中的常微分方程求解未来状态。

03
差异

模型同时约束动力学表示空间和潜速度场的常微分方程性质，从而支持任意时间分辨率与反向预测。

04
证据

摘要称其在视频生成和机器人控制实验中兼顾了有利于规划的动态抽象与视觉重建质量，并改善了长时预测后的图像重建。

摘要

该工作提出物理时间流，通过学习物理时间中的连续潜速度场，将未来预测转化为压缩潜空间中的常微分方程积分，并据此构建连续时间潜世界模型。模型旨在缓解潜世界模型中的表示坍塌，在长时预测后保持高质量图像重建，同时支持任意时间分辨率、反向预测和面向规划的信息；摘要称其在视频生成和机器人控制中取得了良好效果。

几何形状不同但功能相同的物体之间，稠密特征近邻匹配会产生空间不连贯的对应关系，无法恢复可靠操作所需的局部几何坐标系。

02
方法

方法通过联合位姿与对应关系优化选择语义一致的锚点区域，再用功能映射将约束传播到物体表面。

03
差异

该方法不需要训练，并同时约束对应关系的语义一致性与几何连贯性，而不是仅依赖稠密视觉描述子的最近邻匹配。

04
证据

在基于PartNet-Mobility构建的稠密对应基准上达到90.8%的语义准确率，并在真实操作中以单次示范提升了对未见物体的零样本技能迁移可靠性。

摘要

本文研究在功能相同但几何形状不同的物体实例之间迁移操作技能的问题，提出一种无需训练的方法：通过联合位姿与对应关系优化选择语义一致的锚点区域，并利用功能映射将约束传播到物体表面。该方法在基于PartNet-Mobility的稠密对应基准上达到90.8%的语义准确率并改善几何连贯性，还通过真实机器人实验表明，单次示范即可比现有对应方法更可靠地将操作技能迁移到未见物体。

方法解读
01
问题

论文检验对比式评论家能否安全地为最佳候选选择、规划和评论家引导生成提供价值目标。

02
方法

作者比较无界双线性、余弦和混合评论家，并用支持集分解、训练与读出分解及模拟器滚动评估误差来源。

03
差异

研究将动作兼容性排序与可最大化的价值排序区分开来，并与参数量匹配的贝尔曼训练时序差分价值函数比较。

04
证据

四个导航任务中评论家在最高分位的校准较弱或反向，且多数候选池会选出分布外动作；单步选择代价在点迷宫和精确最优价值玩具任务中出现，但在蚂蚁迷宫和人形迷宫中未得到有力差异。

摘要

动作排序良好并不意味着对比式评论家适合被最大化：无界双线性分数会通过嵌入范数抬高分布外动作的分数，而余弦约束也不能消除这一问题。四个导航任务显示，余弦和混合评论家常从候选池中选出分布外动作，在最高分位校准较弱或反向，且不能按价值排序固定查询动作；贝尔曼训练的时序差分价值函数则能做到这一点。结果表明，候选最大化会利用范数漂移、分数饱和或支持集内误排序造成的假阳性，因此动作选择需要经过价值校准的标量，尽管对比式评论家仍可作为导航和操作任务中的兼容性排序器。

方法解读
01
问题

多模态大模型难以稳定处理细粒度空间关系和物体幻觉，单靠粗粒度深度分层也无法区分同一平面内的关系。

02
方法

系统用开放词汇目标检测器提取物体，并计算成对的投影与拓扑几何关系，再将人类可读的空间谓词和单目深度线索加入提示。

03
差异

它在既有深度分层提示之上补充了物体到物体的二维空间语义，且整个流程无需训练。

04
证据

在视觉空间推理和图像理解基准上进行多模型评测，其中在一个空间子集上相对既有方法提升百分之四十六的调和平均值，并在另一基准上达到零点五三的调和平均值。

摘要

论文提出一种无需训练的空间推理方法，将单目深度线索与目标之间的投影和拓扑关系结合，并以可审计的自然语言谓词注入多模态大模型提示，以减少空间判断中的幻觉。该方法在多个视觉空间推理基准和多种模型上评测，在一个空间子集上相对既有深度提示方法取得百分之四十六的调和平均值提升，并在中央处理器上以严格的四十词元上下文预算运行。

RoboBRIDGE: A Modular Framework for Bridging Policies to Robust Real-World Robotic Agents

Sihyung Yoon, Minjong Yoo, Sanghyun Ahn, Seojeong Choi, Honguk Woo
low · 2026-07-30

为什么值得看 它主要解决视觉语言动作策略在真实机器人上的故障恢复、长程执行和跨域鲁棒性，而不是学习环境动力学或构建可用于预测与规划的世界模型，因此对本方向只提供有限的策略编排参考。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

预训练视觉语言动作模型缺少失败恢复机制，在长时程执行以及观测、任务和机器人形态变化下鲁棒性有限。

02
方法

系统由监控器、感知器、规划器、控制器和机器人接口五个模块组成，并协调现成模型完成检测、恢复、重规划和执行。

03
差异

控制器用带专用低秩适配器的领域不变原语进行微调，同时允许感知异步更新和规划触发重规划。

04
证据

在自由空间操作基准、机器人家居基准及多个平台和视觉语言动作骨干的真实案例中，作者称其持续优于独立策略和既有增强部署方案。

摘要

视觉语言动作模型虽能有效预测动作，但直接部署为机器人代理时会面临失败恢复不足、长时程执行不一致以及对观测、任务和机器人形态变化不够鲁棒等问题。该工作提出一个由监控器、感知器、规划器、控制器和机器人接口组成的模块化编排框架，用失败检测与分层恢复、异步场景更新、重规划以及基于低秩适配器的操作原语微调，将预训练模型组合成更稳健的机器人代理；作者报告其在多个模拟基准和真实机器人案例中优于独立策略及既有增强部署方案。

Rethinking Inference-Time Scaling in Local Computer-Use Agents: Failure Modes and Compute Tradeoffs

Woongkyu Lee, Jungwook Choi
low · 2026-07-30

为什么值得看 它说明本地计算机操作代理增加推理计算并不会稳定地提升任务成功率，反而可能把失败从卡住转为过早误判成功，因此对研究受限算力下的世界模型代理控制有参考价值，但并非直接研究世界模型。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

论文研究资源受限的本地计算机操作代理在执行时增加计算是否有效，以及不同扩展方式会产生哪些失败模式。

02
方法

作者在操作系统世界基准上评估三类本地模型，并从上下文、时间、结构和并行四个维度分析推理时扩展。

03
差异

研究不只比较成功率，还区分额外历史信息、延长执行步数、任务分解和并行计算如何改变代理行为与失败类型。

04
证据

结果显示上下文扩展提升轨迹稳定性但收益趋于饱和，时间扩展减少步数耗尽却未明显提升成功率，结构分解增加开销而并行扩展需付出较高计算成本。

摘要

论文系统研究本地计算机操作代理的推理时扩展，在操作系统世界基准上评估三种本地模型，并考察上下文、时间、结构和并行四个维度。结果表明，额外计算通常收益递减且会改变失败模式：上下文扩展可改善历史 grounding、轨迹稳定性和任务准确率但最终饱和，时间扩展减少最长步数导致的停滞却常只是延长错误轨迹，结构分解会带来规划与格式开销，而并行扩展能部分缓解失败但计算代价较高。

Arm2Air: Cross-Embodiment Skeleton Transfer for 3D Relay Formation

Dohun Lee, Kyeonghyun Yoo, Seokmin Kim, Byongho Lee, Seungjoo Oh, Hwangnam Kim
low · 2026-07-30

为什么值得看 它展示了如何把机器人手臂的有序避障骨架迁移到无人机中继布置，并在仅有三个目标域地图时以更少参数降低误差，但没有学习或使用可用于预测环境演化的世界模型。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

城市三维中继布置需要同时处理视线遮挡、通信范围、高度、障碍物和链路质量约束。

02
方法

方法将预训练神经运动规划模型产生的机械臂动作转换为有序骨架，用变换器迁移平台和低秩适配迁移到无人机域，再优化中继链。

03
差异

它迁移跨具身的结构先验，而不是为无人机任务从零训练或完全微调模型。

04
证据

在九张高密度城市地图上规划运行时间中位数较最快传统规划器降低百分之六十四点九，并在数据稀缺实验中以较少更新参数降低位置误差。

摘要

论文把预训练神经运动规划模型中的机器人手臂避障动作转化为有序骨架，用于预训练跨具身迁移平台，并通过低秩适配迁移到无人机中继布置任务。迁移得到的骨架先初始化中继链，再针对连通性、瓶颈容量、时延和移动成本进行优化；实验显示，该方法在复杂城市地图上降低规划时间并改善多项链路指标，在仅使用三个目标域地图时也优于从头训练。

Kalman Meets Curriculum: Efficient Dynamic Prompt Selection for Adaptive RL Finetuning

Haodong Zhu, Yangyang Ren, Yanjing Li, Sheng Xu, Haiguang Liu, Linlin Yang et al.
low · 2026-07-30

为什么值得看 它针对强化学习微调中的非平稳题目难度，用卡尔曼滤波减少评估回滚次数并保持中等难度样本供训练，但不涉及世界模型、环境模拟或潜在动力学，因此对本方向研究者主要是训练数据调度层面的旁支参考。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

强化学习微调时题目难度会随策略变化，静态难度预测失效而逐题评估又代价高。

02
方法

方法在对数几率空间用线性高斯状态空间模型表示每道题的潜在成功率，并用卡尔曼滤波更新后验分布。

03
差异

过程噪声随策略更新幅度增加，使题目选择能响应策略漂移并优先选择中等难度及不确定题目。

04
证据

在数学、规划和几何推理基准及多种强化学习算法上，作者称其提升最终准确率和回滚效率，并在蒸馏模型六个数学基准上少用百分之八十三回滚且平均性能提高零点一二分。

摘要

论文将强化学习微调中的题目选择重新表述为动态状态估计问题，用卡尔曼滤波追踪题目潜在成功率，并让过程噪声随策略更新幅度变化。作者称该方法无需额外回滚，在多个推理基准和强化学习算法上同时提升最终准确率与回滚效率；在某七十亿参数推理模型的六个数学基准上，回滚次数减少百分之八十三，平均性能提高零点一二分。

LabEvolver: Training-Free Experience Evolution for Safe and Grounded Wet-Lab Agents

Jingya Wang, Yuyang Gao, Liuzhenghao Lv, Yonghong Tian, Yuyang Liu
low · 2026-07-30

为什么值得看 它说明执行轨迹可以在不更新模型参数的情况下沉淀为技能、策略和安全经验，但核心贡献属于具身智能体的记忆与规划，而非学习环境动力学或构建世界模型。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

湿实验智能体需要在真实执行中适应感知、规划并持续验证安全性。

02
方法

系统以内循环进行状态对齐的试验、在线规划和安全校验，再以内循环演化完成轨迹并提炼可复用经验。

03
差异

该方法通过经验演化增强智能体，而不是依赖额外训练来获得能力。

04
证据

在机器人溶液配制任务中，论文报告酸碱度调节完成时间减少百分之四十八点二、安全门拦截减少百分之六十。

摘要

论文提出一种无需训练的经验演化框架，为安全且状态对齐的湿实验智能体加入基于执行经验的情景记忆。该框架结合用于自适应感知、在线规划和安全验证的内循环，以及将完成轨迹提炼为技能、策略和安全经验的外循环；在机器人溶液配制任务和模拟交互环境中，论文分别报告了执行效率、安全拦截和连续任务成功率的提升。

Beyond Rephrasing: Book-Level Organization Improves Synthetic Textbook Data for Mid-Training

Jiawen Tao, Miao Peng, Yaoming Li, Xiaokun Yuan, Mengzhou Wu, Wenhan Yu et al.
low · 2026-07-30

为什么值得看 它说明合成训练数据的收益也取决于书级主题组织而不只是改写质量，但研究对象是语言模型预训练数据而非世界模型、动态建模或基于模型的决策。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

研究合成教材数据的收益是否来自相关内容被组织成连贯的书级文档。

02
方法

系统从预训练语料检索材料，聚类主题单元，规划分层目录，并组装成有来源依据的完整教材。

03
差异

通过内容匹配的分段、随机拼接和逐文档改写对照，单独检验文档包装、长度与结构化合成的作用。

04
证据

完整教材设置生成六十八万六千本、三百二十亿词元，并在混合训练中带来平均一点评测提升；对照实验也支持书级组织的贡献。

摘要

论文研究相关内容是否应被组织成连贯的书级文档，而不是仅进行局部改写或独立生成。其流水线从预训练语料检索并聚类材料、规划分层目录、组装成完整教材，构建了覆盖一万五千多个学科的六十八万六千本教材；受控实验显示，相比分段文档、随机拼接、逐文档改写和自然书籍，书级组织能提升中期训练后的下游表现。

Evaluating Agentic Bioinformatics through Function, Evidence, and Validation

Phuc Pham, Truong-Son Hy
low · 2026-07-30

为什么值得看 它把生物信息学智能体的评估重点从最终答案转向可检查的工作流、证据来源和任务验证，但与世界模型的学习动力学、模拟或基于模型的决策基本无关。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

现有评估难以判断智能体生成的生物分析流程是否科学可信，因为工具调用成功和基准表现不足以证明有效性。

02
方法

框架将智能体工作流拆为已展示的操作、可追溯的行动与主张证据，以及针对具体用途的验证。

03
差异

它把可检查的工作流轨迹而非系统架构或最终输出设为主要分析单位。

04
证据

研究用该框架整理了涵盖多个生物信息学领域的109个智能体或相关系统及28个评估资源，对应128篇独立论文。

摘要

文章指出，生物信息学智能体虽然越来越能够规划、执行和解释分析，但流畅回答、工具调用成功或基准成绩并不能单独证明科学可信度。文章提出功能—证据—验证框架，整理了多个领域的智能体系统与评估资源，并发现规划和工具执行的发展快于可复现性、溯源、稳健科学评估、外部验证和前瞻性实证测试，因此主张按工作流正确性而非仅按最终答案正确性评估此类系统。

Machines that know they are aging: a framework for hardware-aware autonomous intelligence

Cheng Siong Chin, Jianhua Zhang, Mohan Venkateshkumar
low · 2026-07-30

为什么值得看 它把电池、传感器、存储和计算部件的退化纳入推理与任务规划，可为太空、海洋和植入式设备中的长期自主运行提供比固定硬件假设更稳健的降级策略，但与世界模型本身的联系较弱。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

现有自主智能通常假设硬件状态不变，因而可能因累积退化而出现任务失败。

02
方法

该框架用失效物理模型持续估计电源、感知、存储和计算子系统的健康度，并据此调整推理、规划和任务优先级。

03
差异

它将硬件自感知、自适应推理和按剩余寿命分配任务统一到闭环认知架构中，而不是只处理单个部件故障。

04
证据

摘要声称该整合能提升韧性、延长运行寿命并支持更平稳的任务完成，但未给出实验数据或具体性能增益。

摘要

自主系统会因电池老化、传感器漂移、处理器计时误差累积和存储可靠性下降而逐渐偏离其原有能力，进而可能因硬件退化而非单一故障导致任务失败。文章提出面向老化感知的自主智能框架，通过硬件健康估计、自适应推理和以生存为中心的任务分配，将预后、生命周期管理与硬件感知计算纳入闭环架构，以延长太空、海洋机器人和植入式医疗设备等系统的安全运行时间。

论文 / 高优先级

Failure Detection for Surgical Robot Imitation Policies via Flow-Matching World Modeling

分类主题latent dynamics
Zhefeng Huang, Yilin Cai, Ankit Patel, Mohammad Hajiha, Brendan Browne, Yue Chen
high · 2026-07-29

为什么值得看 它把短时动作条件视觉世界模型与保序校准结合起来，在没有失败示范的情况下检测手术机器人策略的视觉—动作不一致，为安全关键任务提供了比预测误差更少误报的在线护栏。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

手术机器人模仿策略面临失败样本稀缺、操作动力学变化大以及漏报与误报难以平衡的问题。

02
方法

方法用动作条件流匹配世界模型学习成功执行的短时视觉动力学，并依据观测终点潜变量的逆传输非一致性进行窗口级检测。

03
差异

它只用成功执行进行保序校准来设定任务专属阈值，不要求预先知道未来失败类型，也不依赖失败示范。

04
证据

在四项手术相关操作、二十种失败模式以及仿真和真实实验中，该方法超过观测级异常基线和同一世界模型的预测误差变体，腕部相机达到百分之九十六点六的失败检出率和百分之一点三的误报率。

摘要

论文提出流匹配世界模型失败检测方法，用动作条件流匹配世界模型学习正常的短时视觉动力学，并通过观测终点潜变量的逆传输非一致性检测视觉—动作不一致。方法在成功执行上进行保序校准以获得任务专属报警阈值，无需失败示范或预先假设失败类型；在四项手术相关操作、二十种失败模式及仿真和真实实验中，其表现超过观测级异常检测基线和预测误差变体，腕部相机取得百分之九十六点六的失败检出率与百分之一点三的误报率。

Learning to Understand Body Language from Flight through Robust 3D Avatar Placing

分类主题learned simulators
Dragos Costea, Alina Marcu, Cristina Lazar, Marius Leordeanu
low · 2026-07-30

方法解读
01
问题

手术机器人模仿策略面临失败样本稀缺、操作动力学变化大以及漏报与误报难以平衡的问题。

02
方法

方法用动作条件流匹配世界模型学习成功执行的短时视觉动力学，并依据观测终点潜变量的逆传输非一致性进行窗口级检测。

03
差异

它只用成功执行进行保序校准来设定任务专属阈值，不要求预先知道未来失败类型，也不依赖失败示范。

04
证据

在四项手术相关操作、二十种失败模式以及仿真和真实实验中，该方法超过观测级异常基线和同一世界模型的预测误差变体，腕部相机达到百分之九十六点六的失败检出率和百分之一点三的误报率。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

远距离无人机画面中的人体动作和沟通意图缺少真实、带精确空间标注的训练数据。

02
方法

方法用语义选出的场景锚点和流式单目深度建立局部几何模型，再以仿射锚点组合预测放置点，并通过奇异值分解拟合地面旋转来重渲染人体化身。

03
差异

数据中的人体化身被放入未经修改的四千像素无人机场景，并在数百帧相机运动中保持位置、尺度和朝向的度量一致性。

04
证据

在十二种架构、场景与动作均不重叠的划分上，合成放置数据大幅提升了真实、重定向和生成动作的意图准确率，并在两个自然场景中得到验证。

摘要

论文提出一个由无人机真实影像构成的人体语言数据集，将表达十种沟通意图的三维人体化身放入未经修改的四千像素航拍场景，并在相机运动的数百帧中保持度量正确的位置、尺度和朝向。其放置方法使用语义锚点、流式单目深度和具有刚体不变权重的仿射组合，并通过奇异值分解拟合地面旋转进行重渲染；在十二种架构的场景与动作互斥测试中，该数据提升了多类动作的意图识别准确率，并在两个自然场景上得到确认。
